mapper.select: select count(*) as total_events, count(distinct phrase_id) as unique_phrases, count(distinct activity_id) as unique_activities, count(*) filter (where reaction_type = 'cooperating') as cooperating_count, min(client_timestamp) as first_event_at, max(client_timestamp) as last_event_at, count(distinct (client_timestamp at time zone 'UTC')::date) as practiced_days from interaction_events where account_id = #{accountId} and client_timestamp >= #{windowStart} and client_timestamp < #{windowEnd}
